people.role: Founder and head of Hộ Lâm Đường (910): forest wardens; spirit wood for Thúy Vi's furnaces
people.appearance: A big, slow, grey-bearded man in a warden's bark-brown coat, with an axe on his back and a disc of pale heartwood on a cord at his throat.
people.backstory: Lục Thanh Sam was a chandler's son from Bạch Lạp Thôn, the white-wax village of the northern woods. Phùng Yên Hà took him into Thúy Vi's outer gate at eleven, and he dug spirit fields beside Quyền Thanh Lam (quyen_thanh_lam), who was ten years older and already patient. He passed the First Leaf in 880 and asked to stay in the woods with the sect's wardens instead of walking up to the inner gate, and the founder let him. In 910, with the Cold Ford home again and the northern roads quiet (V027), she made the wardens a hall of their own on the edge of the forest. She gave it to him and his sworn brother Sư Tuyết Tùng (su_tuyet_tung) to keep the woods and send the furnaces their spirit wood (V028). The brown bears of Tông Hùng Lâm killed Sư in 990 over a felled log, and Lục still carries the scar of that night. In 960 he took the raft master Đằng Bích Lưu (dang_bich_luu) as his Dao partner. Since then the wood has gone down on the spring flood to the boom at Tân Cư Thôn, and on to the lord in autumn. In 1162 he wrote the hall's own primer, and the hall's Earth half lapsed (N-ho_lam-04). He loads Sầm Ngưu Tất's (sam_nguu_tat) rafts himself. He has refused three times to sell wood to Hồng Lô, and every time to anyone but the lord.
people.wants: To see the Forest of First Light put up a spirit seedling again before he dies, and to hand the hall on still sending the wood.
people.secret: In 1150 Úy Thanh Diễm needed a great spirit tree for the night of his breakthrough over the Green Furnace. Lục sat the night of asking beside the Grandmother Fir of Sơ Hiểu Lâm, and the tree gave no answer. He felled it at dawn anyway and told the hall it had said yes. No spirit seedling has come up in that forest since. The only other person who sat that night is Mi Túc Thụ.

people.role: Raft master; rides the spring flood with the year's wood
people.appearance: A loud, weathered woman, river-scarred hands, a green banner rolled under her arm.
people.backstory: A raftsman's daughter from the river village of Thủy Ma Thôn who brought the Spring Flood Raft Art to the hall in 960. In the same year she became Lục Thanh Sam's (luc_thanh_sam) Dao partner. She has ridden the lead raft down every spring flood since. Their son Lục Lưu Mộc (luc_luu_moc) is 190 and has ten years left, and she is not taking it well.
people.wants: To keep her son alive past this spring's flood, and to ride one more lead raft with him aboard.
people.secret: She is paying Nghệ Hoàng Phong (nghe_hoang_phong) in river pearls for a jar of the spirit honey meant for the lord, hoping it buys Lục Lưu Mộc a year; the hall's tally is a jar short each autumn.

people.role: Warden of the eastern woods; sells spirit logs past the lord
people.appearance: A handsome, restless warden with a merchant's rings under his bark gloves.
people.backstory: A raftsman's son from Phiệt Công Thôn who reckons the hall's wood keeps Thúy Vi's whole alchemy alive and is paid like firewood. He quarrels with the lord's wood-keeper Phí Tùng Chi (phi_tung_chi) over every tally. In 1186 a poacher of Tân Cư Thôn was felling a spirit tree for him; when Phí began counting stumps, Lại handed his own feller to the lord's Hall of Rules, took the reward for the catch, and sold the log anyway. The man's four-year-old son sat on it in the cart and is now in the hall's outer gate. In 1199 he sold another log to a Phượng Minh buyer at Lam Yên Thị, and this spring he means to cut a second loose at the boom.
people.wants: To be paid what the hall's wood is worth, and to be the man Thúy Vi's furnaces ask for by name.
people.secret: He is hand-picking Thiệu Tùng Lâm's (thieu_tung_lam) poacher watch to look away on the night of the second log, paying them out of the first log's price; the notch he forged in the 1199 tally is the only thing that would show it.

people.role: The Listener: keeps the rite of asking
people.appearance: A thin woman with moss on her sleeves, who speaks so quietly that people lean in and looks at trees as if they were talking.
people.backstory: A herb-gatherer's daughter from Tử Tô Thôn who has sat about four thousand nights beside spirit trees for the rite of asking. In 1150 she sat beside the Grandmother Fir with Lục Thanh Sam (luc_thanh_sam) on the night before it was felled for Úy Thanh Diễm's (uy_thanh_diem) breakthrough. Since then she has gone back to Sơ Hiểu Lâm every spring to look for seedlings.
people.wants: To find one living spirit seedling in Sơ Hiểu Lâm before Lục Thanh Sam dies, so he can stop pretending the Grandmother Fir said yes.
people.secret: Each spring she plants a seedling she raised in a sleeve-pot at the edge of Sơ Hiểu Lâm and swears it was found there, so that Lục may believe the forest forgives him; Tô Miêu Nhi (to_mieu_nhi) carries the pot and thinks it is an offering.

people.backstory: A boy of Bạch Lạp Thôn who went into Thúy Vi's outer gate with Lục Thanh Sam (luc_thanh_sam) and swore brotherhood with him on the first night they spent beside a spirit tree. He co-founded the hall in 910 (V028). In the winter of 990 the brown bears of Tông Hùng Lâm came for a felled spirit log, which smells of qi, and he stood over it until Lục came. Lục came too late.
